title: Whole-card crate links, crate names in feed, profile crate links, singular counts, stale store
description: 1) AC10 defect: on Home, a real click anywhere on a recommended crate card must go to /crates/<id>. Today only the tape label at HomeView.vue:84 is a RouterLink (7% of the card); a click on the crate name stays on /. Use a stretched link (the RouterLink ::after covers the positioned card) with a pointer cursor and a visible focus state, and give the link an accessible name containing the crate name. No nested interactive elements. 2) Feed cards on /following show only the tape label: also show the crate name and make the whole card a link in the same way. 3) Crates listed on /profile and /u/<username> are not links: make each open /crates/<id>. 4) Follower count: show '1 follower' for a count of 1, otherwise 'N followers'. Keep the .follower-count and .following-count elements, and apply this wherever the count renders. 5) Stale store: CrateView calls library.load() without force, so navigating to /crates/<id> for a crate the already loaded store does not know shows 'Crate not found' until reload. When the id is not in the loaded store, force one reload before showing not found; /crates/999999 must still end at 'Crate not found' with no loop. Add or update tests for each. Files may be missing from this list if a test lives elsewhere: if you need another file, report a blocker rather than touching it.
